C0757.title: Ctrip Fined RMB 10 Million for Failing to Conduct Data Export Security Assessment
C0757.summary: On June 13, 2026, the Shanghai Cyberspace Administration fined Shanghai Ctrip Commerce Co., Ltd. RMB 10 million for failing to implement data export security assessment requirements and illegally transferring personal information abroad, in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Law. The company was also ordered to rectify the violations within a prescribed period. This case serves as

references.title: Ctrip Fined 10 Million: Failure to Implement Data Export Security Assessment, Illegal Outbound Transfer of Personal Information
